Theorem
[Asymptotic cone] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0486, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0488, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0489 ↗ lem:chow-iii-i27-pseudometric 1. appi:1.26\group Asymptotic cones

If $(\M ^n,g)$ is complete, noncompact, and has $\sect (g)\ge 0$, then the pointed rescalings $(\M ,\lambda ^2g,p)$ converge as $\lambda \downarrow 0$ to the Euclidean metric cone $\operatorname {Cone}(\M (\infty ),\ddinf )$.
